You: Here’s the money, alright? Now, if you excuse me…
Landlord: Not so fast.
Landlord: Did you honestly think I would let you get away with it?! {{wi}}{{punch}}GET OUT NOW!
You: Wait, wait, wait! We can make a deal, right? 100$ raise, like the last time!
Landlord: 200$ raise.
You: 200$?! That’s outrageous!
Landlord: 250$
You: What?!
Landlord: Keep negotiating and it will soon go to 300$
You: Alright! 250$...
Landlord: Attaboy. {{wi}}When will you learn? Well, it’s not like it’s my problem. Hahaha!
#Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.5)
Landlord: Hahahaha!
You: Grrr!
I will get back at him! I promise!
